Winter break · December

NBA and College Pathway Camp 2026

Three days on what NBA and college coaches look for, ages 13 to 17
  • 3 days
  • Measured like the NBA Draft Combine
  • Film of your own game
  • A written evaluation to take home
  • Your game film, packaged
  • NBA coaches live on a video call
  • The shooting machine
  • Hot lunch Monday and Tuesday
  • The camp t-shirt
  • 1.795 kr
Ages
13 to 17
Days
Three days. Monday 28 to Wednesday 30 December
Time
09:30 to 14:00
Where
Hafnia-Hallen, Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 København SV
Places
50
Price
1.795 kr to Sunday 15 November, then 1.995 kr
Sign up for the December camp

What you do

You get measured, you get filmed, and you get a written evaluation on the last day. Height, wingspan, standing reach, vertical and lane agility are the tests NBA scouts run at the Draft Combine.

A day at camp

09:30 to 11:30
Testing and skills. Height, wingspan, standing reach, vertical, lane agility and timed shooting
11:30 to 12:30
Lunch, then film. Your own footage from the morning
12:30 to 14:00
Live play, filmed from a fixed camera
Wed 30 Dec
Game day. Warm up from 09:30, games from 10:30 to 14:00, filmed. Fruit and snacks, no lunch. Each player gets a written evaluation at the end

Your skills coach: Tremaine Dalton

Tremaine Dalton is on court with Deng all three days. He is an NBA Camp Director of Technique in Europe, a Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame nominee and the founder of The Process Basketball. He runs sessions with you and leads the Coaches Clinic on Monday and Tuesday. Bring your questions.

NBA coaches on the call

One day of camp, NBA coaches join us on a live video call. They tell you how they got there and what they look for in a player. Bring your questions.

In December 2024 Toronto Raptors coaches Noah Lewis and Rashaun Broadus joined our camp on a video call. Noah is now head coach of the Raptors 905, Toronto's G League team.

Game day and your film

Wednesday 30 December is game day. Games start at 10:30 and every game is filmed from a fixed camera. You can watch your own footage the same day.

After camp we package your game film together with your written evaluation and share it with you. It is yours to keep and to send on to a coach.

The pathway

The numbers from Monday, the film from game day and the written evaluation are what a prep school or college coach asks to see. This camp gives you all three in one place.

Talata players have gone on to Orangeville Prep in Canada and Martins Ferry High School in Ohio. See where they went.

Questions parents ask

What do they bring?

Indoor shoes and a water bottle. Lunch on Monday and Tuesday, fruit and snacks all three days and the camp t-shirt come from us, and the shooting machine is in the hall all three days.

Drop off and pick up?

Start 09:30, pick up 14:00, all three days.

Who is it for?

Players aged 13 to 17 who are already in a club and want to know where they stand.

Who else is in the gym?

On Monday and Tuesday, coaches from other clubs join for our Coaches Clinic. They run stations and take the game teams with our coaches, and they are welcome back for Wednesday's games.

Sign up

50 places. We confirm by email and send the payment details.
